```plato
//==
// # Escape-time fractal parameters
//
// The parameter records of escape-time fractals in the 2D and 4D number
// systems: quadratic Julia sets and Mandelbrot views in the complex plane, and
// their quaternion counterpart. Iteration caps are dimensionless counts;
// escape radii are in the units of the number system being iterated.

// Parameters of a quadratic Julia set in the complex plane: z maps to
// z^2 + C. Iteration stops at MaxIterations or when the magnitude of z
// exceeds EscapeRadius (complex-plane units, at least 2).
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Julia_set)
type JuliaSetParameters
    implements IValue
{
    C: Complex;
    MaxIterations: Integer;
    EscapeRadius: Number;
}
```
